Installation commands for the desktop application.

```bash
brew install --cask opencode-desktop
```

```bash

```

--------------------------------

### Instalando o aplicativo desktop OpenCode (BETA)

Source: https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/blob/dev/README.br.md

Instale a versão desktop do OpenCode usando gerenciadores de pacotes específicos para macOS e Windows.

```bash
# macOS (Homebrew)
brew install --cask opencode-desktop
```

```bash
# Windows (Scoop)
scoop bucket add extras; scoop install extras/opencode-desktop
```

--------------------------------

### Instalacija OpenCode CLI putem različitih package managera

Source: https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/blob/dev/README.bs.md

Instalirajte OpenCode CLI koristeći preferirani package manager za vaš operativni sistem, uključujući npm, Scoop, Chocolatey, Homebrew, Pacman, Paru, mise i Nix.

```bash
# Package manageri
npm i -g opencode-ai@latest        # ili bun/pnpm/yarn
scoop install opencode             # Windows
choco install opencode             # Windows
brew install anomalyco/tap/opencode # macOS i Linux (preporučeno, uvijek ažurno)
brew install opencode              # macOS i Linux (zvanična brew formula, rjeđe se ažurira)
sudo pacman -S opencode            # Arch Linux (Stable)
paru -S opencode-bin               # Arch Linux (Latest from AUR)
mise use -g opencode               # Bilo koji OS
nix run nixpkgs#opencode           # ili github:anomalyco/opencode za najnoviji dev branch
```

--------------------------------

### YOLO Installation

Source: https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/blob/dev/README.md

Quick installation using curl.

```bash
curl -fsSL https://opencode.ai/install | bash
```

--------------------------------

### Instalacija OpenCode desktop aplikacije putem package managera

Source: https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/blob/dev/README.bs.md

Instalirajte OpenCode desktop aplikaciju na macOS (Homebrew) ili Windows (Scoop) koristeći ove komande.

# macOS (Homebrew)
